supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Significant extension beyond the lateral canthi of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-grey muzzle/chin and the dark-charcoal periocular/cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin lower lip with a visible structural droop in a neutral state

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, prominent white patch of fur or depigmentation on the central-upper forehead
